plain_english_policy: This bill amends the Alabama Constitution to expand the powers of a specific local entity in Franklin County. Currently, this 'Water Coordinating and Fire Prevention Authority' is authorized by law to provide water and fire protection services. This amendment legally allows that same authority to also build and operate sewer systems and broadband internet networks within Franklin County.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would permanently authorize the Franklin County Water Coordinating and Fire Prevention Authority to offer sewage treatment/sewerage and high-speed internet (broadband) services. It grants this public corporation the legal standing, eminent domain rights, ability to issue bonds for funding these new projects, and the power to set rates specifically for sewer and broadband without charging those debts against Franklin County's general debt limit.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Morrow sponsored this bill as a Constitutional Amendment. By advancing it to the floor for ratification by voters, Representative Morrow supports expanding local government infrastructure capabilities in Franklin County.
evidence_quotes: To amend Amendment 518 of the Constitution of Alabama of 1901, relating to the Franklin County, to allow the Franklin County Water Coordinating and Fire Prevention Authority to provide sewer services and broadband services in the county.

provide any one or more of the following local public services: Obtain, treat, and furnish water, provide sewer services, and broadband Internet service for residential, commercial, or industrial purposes

Relating to Franklin County, proposing an amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 1901, to allow the Franklin County Water Coordinating and Fire Prevention Authority to provide sewer services and broadband Internet services in the county.
review_reason: The bill text is clear. It explicitly amends a constitutional provision for one specific local authority (Franklin Co.) regarding three distinct infrastructure types: water, sewage, and broadband.
